articles.model: GPT-6 Astra Medium · Sol source/completeness review
articles.availability_note: DOE issued Order 202-26-25B on November 17, 2026, effective November 18–December 31. PJM’s zero remaining hours is an attributed estimate of regulatory allowance, not fuel or physical capacity. The order retains anticipated-alert and FERC-settlement dispatch routes, reporting, environmental obligations and operating parameters. The settlement route includes required testing in the application’s excerpt. The order and renewal PDFs and official chronology were inspected; actual generation, costs, emissions, grid models and broader court-docket outcomes were not independently verified.

articles.availability_note: 能源部于2026年11月17日签发202-26-25B号命令，11月18日至12月31日生效。PJM所称剩余零小时，是获准运行额度的估计，并非燃料或物理容量。命令保留预期警报与FERC和解协议两条调度路径，以及报告、环境义务和运行参数；申请摘录中的和解路径包括必要测试。本文查阅命令、续期申请与官方时间线，未独立核实实际发电、成本、排放、电网模型或更广泛法院程序结果。
